title: Define freshness and correction policy for stratum tracking
description: Correctness/security review finding. python/src/lichen/timing/time_sync.py:190-198 and 235-259 update mutable tracker state whenever a received stratum is strictly higher. They do not compare the projected current wall clock, bound forward jumps, prevent backward steps, record sample age/sequence, or recover from an invalidated source. Conversely, equal-stratum samples are always rejected; python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:153-175 locks that behavior in, so a selected source can never refresh or correct its timestamp and the tracker becomes sticky at stratum 4. This conflicts with docs/firmware-time-provider.md:104-118, which requires fresher-sample preference and explicit policy before backward correction, and leaves far-future poisoning possible.
acceptance_criteria: Specify and implement a correction/freshness policy based on current accepted Unix time projected from monotonic observation, sample observation time/age, source identity/trust, and configurable backward/forward correction bounds. Reject stale, replayed, implausibly far-future, and unauthorized backward samples without mutating tracker state. Permit a fresher valid equal-stratum sample when policy allows, including periodic refresh; define source switching and recovery when the current source expires or is invalidated. Preserve lower-stratum rejection unless explicit failover policy applies. Tests must cover backward step, forward-jump bound, duplicate/replay, out-of-order sample, valid equal-stratum refresh, source expiry/failover, recovery from poisoned/stale state, and monotonic advancement between samples. Update normative docs/vectors and run focused tests plus three code-review passes per modified source module.
notes: Independent security review: per-sample forward bounds can be ratcheted repeatedly, and expiry/clear resets to the much larger initial lead. Retain last-good projected anchor across expiry, define cumulative correction/slew budget, and require stronger re-bootstrap for large jumps.
